title: Choose the visual world
question: One direction is ready for the resume. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Lit Bay
options.lineage: A Pune IT-park tower after the other floors have gone dark
options.thesis: The current job is the one window still lit; the career is the rest of the facade, and you drag it.
options.viewport: The facade fills the frame and runs off both edges. MOHD SOHEL DESHMUKH is etched into the glass at building scale. One bay glows tungsten: Senior Software Engineer, Biz4Solutions, April 2025 – Present. A lobby plate at the glass line is the email, pressable. Darker floors below are the earlier roles, dates only.
options.risk: If the glass is only a dark theme with a warm spot, it collapses into the portfolio template this site already is.

raised.raise: The name and role are cut into the glass at monumental scale, not captioned beside a picture of a building.
The current role swells until the lit bay leaves the frame on two sides. Earlier jobs are coastlines in the glass, not equal cards.
The near pane (now) and the far floors (then) travel at different speeds, so a drag has depth.
One light does all the modeling. Tungsten is the only warm ink; everything else is the glass’s own blue-black.

options.label: The Visiting Card
options.lineage: The cotton card an engineer hands across a desk in Pune
options.thesis: The whole first screen is one thick card: name, designation, and the email you would actually use.
options.viewport: One visiting card fills the viewport, edge and thickness visible. Debossed: MOHD SOHEL DESHMUKH. Under it, Senior Software Engineer, Biz4Solutions. The email is set like a telephone number and is the only action.
options.risk: A large cotton card and a debossed name is where refined resume sites usually land.

options.label: Paper Lanterns
options.lineage: Washi lamps folded over bamboo, one bulb deciding which volume is inhabited
options.thesis: Each role is a paper volume. The present job is the one lit from inside; the earlier ones wait folded flat.
options.viewport: A dim room. One tall paper column glows, the name on the washi, Senior Software Engineer readable through the light. Three flat rib outlines on the wall are the earlier jobs. The email is a vermilion stamp you press.
options.case: Holds clarity: lit means now, folded means then, the stamp is the email. It loses the scene a Pune recruiter actually walks into.
options.risk: Reads as a lighting catalogue if the role is not the first thing the glow reveals.

options.label: Teletext Magazine
options.lineage: A broadcast teletext magazine, forty columns by twenty-four rows
options.thesis: The resume is a keyed magazine: page 100 is who he is now, and every fact occupies a cell.
options.viewport: A 40 by 24 grid on black. Header P100 DESHMUKH. Double-height yellow: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER. Cyan: BIZ4SOLUTIONS, APR 2025 – PRESENT. The email is a white line. The bottom row says 101–104 are the earlier roles.
options.case: Holds clarity: a recruiter can read the role in one blink. It loses the audience’s scene, and it replaces the drag with a keypad.
options.risk: Becomes a retro novelty the moment the grid stops being strict.

options.label: Linocut Broadside
options.lineage: A strike poster gouged from one block
options.thesis: The role is a demand carved into the same sheet as the figure.
options.viewport: One sheet, a figure filling three quarters, the designation cut underneath with the same knife.
options.case: A strike poster turns a still-employed engineer into a campaign.
options.kept: Identity is cut into the material at monumental scale, not captioned beside it.
options.risk: Reads political, which this record is not.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.lineage: A summer zoo map of swelling colour lobes
options.thesis: Each employer is a headland, and the present job owns the sheet.
materials: a cream ground showing through as water
options.viewport: One green lobe leaves the frame on two sides, the name set in a single grotesk, a yellow capsule for email.
options.case: A garden map is a day out, not a hiring decision.
options.kept: The current role swells until it leaves the frame. Earlier roles stay coastlines, not equal cards.
options.risk: Cheerful in a way that softens nine years of enterprise work.

options.label: Multiplane Dawn
options.lineage: Hand-painted forest planes and one lamp in a cottage window
options.thesis: Time is depth: the near plane is now, the far ridge is 2017.
options.viewport: Layered forest, a cottage lamp as the only warm point, the name on the nearest clear cel.
options.case: A forest dawn hides the office the work actually happens in.
options.kept: The near plane and the far planes travel at different speeds.
options.risk: Picturesque, and the job disappears into the painting.

options.label: Glyph Scene
options.lineage: A live scene drawn only with typewriter characters
options.thesis: The tower and the name are one monospace grid, tone made by glyph density.
options.viewport: The facade rebuilt from glyphs, the lit bay the densest characters, the email a caption inside the same grid.
options.case: Density hides the role a recruiter has to read in one pass.
options.kept: One ink does all the modeling. No second accent.
options.risk: A terminal costume, which is the portfolio this page is trying not to be.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The developer portfolio this category always ships: a dark hero, a name, two buttons, then cards.
canonCard.viewport: Centered hello, the full name, a Senior Software Engineer badge, Get in Touch and View Resume, gradient orbs behind. The next section is a row of equal cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other engineer template, including the site as it stands.
